items.title: d) Identification of Chromium radical (Cr³⁺) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: d) Identification of Chromium radical (Cr³⁺): a main subheading of 16.7 Tests for identification of basic radicals, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 346-346.

blocks.text: Saaf test tube mein 4 g sample lein. 10 cm³ distilled water mein ghol lein. Do hisson (parts) mein baant lein.

blocks.caption: Chromium radical ki pehchan
rows: Pehle hisse mein NaOH solution dalein.
Green (sabz) precipitate banta hai jo zyada NaOH dalne par sabz solution ban jata hai.
Doosre hisse mein aqueous ammonia dalein.
Sabz precipitate banta hai jo zyada ammonia mein nahi ghulta.
